title: Slovakian Chicken Salad
description: A refreshing and flavorful salad from Slovakia made with grilled chicken and a hint of Eastern European spices.

ingredients.name: Mixed greens
ingredients.notes: Chopped lettuce and other leafy greens

ingredients.name: Ethereal
ingredients.notes: Ethereal oil or substitute with olive oil

instructions: 1. Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
2. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and your favorite Slovakian spices.
3. Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
4. Chop the grilled chicken into bite-sized pieces.
5. In a large bowl, combine the chopped chicken, mixed greens, diced onion, crushed garlic, and diced cucumber.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together the Ethereal and a pinch of salt.
7. Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
